title: Clayface
verdict: Man, if he's made of clay, why the fuck don't they throw water on him?
review:
This new era of DC, which ended before it could even start, was really cooking some good shit. I watched this recently in theatres and, man, it really delivered. Some scenes felt rushed, especially for an origin story, but once it finally picked up the pace, it really stuck with it. It doesn't pull any punches in showing how fucked up Clayface actually is.

Clayface is one of those villains who is more tragic than evil, and the movie actually tries to show that. I appreciate that they stuck with the original material. It has some great acting by Tom Rhys Harries (yes, I looked it up on Google). He really gets that good-looking-asshole role right.

I hope this gets tied into Robert Pattinson's Batman, but hey, that is definitely not happening because, guess what, they fired James Gunn.

title: Evil Dead II
review:
This is the only movie you'll find on this website with a perfect score, because it is that good. I am heavily biased towards this movie, but man, am I glad I've watched it so many times. It is something that cannot be replicated, and words can't express how special it is.

It was made by the same guy who made the original Spider-Man, Sam Raimi. Bruce Campbell makes Ash feel like a goofy fucking hunk, and God bless him.

Reviewing this is pointless. It is perfect with all its flaws, and that is that.
